definitions.gloss: tea drinking; consumption of tea or coffee
definitions.explanation: The act of drinking tea or coffee, especially in a leisurely or social context. In contemporary Japanese it appears mostly as part of compound words denoting cafes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{喫茶|きっさ}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a tea-and-coffee corner in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学園祭|がくえんさい}→学園祭：19688_gakuensai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧{喫茶|きっさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: At the school festival, our class ran a maid cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{喫茶|きっさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent some quiet time at an old-fashioned cafe with a Showa-era atmosphere.

notes:
Literally "drinking tea". Rarely used as a standalone word in modern speech; it appears mainly in compounds for cafes and tea shops.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧: cafe; coffee shop
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{喫茶|きっさ}: traditional retro cafe (no alcohol)
- ⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧{喫茶|きっさ}: maid cafe
- ⟦コスプレ→コスプレ：07080_kosupure⟧{喫茶|きっさ}: cosplay cafe
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧{喫茶|きっさ}: cat cafe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: cafe — modern loanword, more stylish or Western-leaning
- {茶店|ちゃみせ}: traditional tea house — old-fashioned, often near temples or scenic spots
